data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for generating PDF documents from HTML code templates.
data.what_it_does: Generates PDF documents from HTML strings, HTML files, or HTML file paths on Android and iOS. Supports styling via standard HTML/CSS markers and image embedding.
use_when: You need to generate PDF documents directly from HTML templates or strings.
You want to convert local or remote HTML files into downloadable PDFs.
avoid_when: You need complex layout customization using programmatic canvas drawing instead of HTML/CSS.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports HTML content, local HTML files, and file paths.
Handles custom CSS styling and images.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
Large amounts of images can significantly affect the final file size.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSdkVersion 19 or higher, and iOS 12.0 or higher.
